About SnuggleUp

SnuggleUp is a South African online baby store offering baby essentials, fast local delivery, selected imported products, and practical parenting guides for families and caregivers.

SnuggleUp was started by a South African dad who wanted an easier, more affordable way for parents to shop for baby essentials online.

Customer accounts

Customers may create an account or sign in with Google to manage their profile, wishlist, orders, and delivery tracking. Google sign-in provides only the basic name and email information needed to create and access a SnuggleUp account.

How we use account information

SnuggleUp does not use Google sign-in to post content, read messages, or monitor a customer's Google Account. Account information is handled in accordance with our privacy policy.
